```python
    if not boxes: return 0
    if dim == L: return 1   # all boxes are "points" here → one cell

        weight = allowed_count(a, b-1)  # (b-a) minus 1 if 1514 in [a, b-1]
        if weight == 0: continue
        sub = [bo for bo in boxes if bo[0][dim] <= a and b-1 <= bo[1][dim]]
        if sub: total += weight * _union(sub, dim+1, L)
    return total
```
